republica.name: Republica
republica.classe: The Senate, senators and high officials
republica.lore: Born from the assemblies of the Concord, it still believes it can rebuild the world as it was. The Senate votes on every war: none has ever been rejected.

imperium.name: Imperium
imperium.classe: The General Staff, the Throne and the generals
imperium.lore: The barracks never closed, not even during the Concord. For the Imperium the Fall was not a tragedy: it was a call to arms.
imperium.bonus: Expansion: taking neutral provinces costs 15% less

aristocrazia.name: Aristocracy
aristocrazia.motto: The future belongs to those who can pay for it.
aristocrazia.classe: The Great Houses, nobility and academies
aristocrazia.lore: In the ballrooms they still dance. In the cellars the Houses study the Lumen more deeply than anyone, and pay the price a little at a time.
aristocrazia.bonus: Technology: units -30% cost, but troops -8% growth

cabal.name: Cabal
cabal.motto: Every war has a bill. We keep it.
cabal.classe: The Shadow Council, bankers and secret services
cabal.lore: No one has ever seen the Council gathered. Yet every convoy, every loan, every Fragment sold passes through its hands.
